import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')
from semver.version import Version

test_cases = [
    ('1.2.3-rc1', '1.2.3-rc2'),      # rc1 → rc2 (last segment is 'rc1', not purely numeric but _increment_string works)
    ('1.0.0-rc9', '1.0.0-rc9.0'),     # rc9 → rc9.0 (per m1 requirement - non-numeric last segment)
    ('1.0.0-alpha', '1.0.0-alpha.0'), # alpha → alpha.0 (no digits at all)
    ('1.0.0-rc.9', '1.0.0-rc.10'),    # rc.9 → rc.10 (purely numeric last segment)
]

for ver_str, expected in test_cases:
    v = Version.parse(ver_str)
    result = v.bump_prerelease()
    actual = str(result)
    status = "✓" if actual == expected else "✗"
    print(f"{status} {ver_str} → {actual} (expected {expected})")
